name: Product Approval
description: The Product Approval module for Odoo introduces an extra layer of control by ensuring that newly created or modified products must go through an approval process before becoming available for use in sales, purchase, or inventory operations. Administrators or managers can review product details such as pricing, descriptions, categories, and attributes, and approve or reject them accordingly. This helps businesses maintain clean product data, prevent errors, and enforce compliance with internal policies, ensuring that only validated products are available across the system.

description:
